checks.name: validity_days
checks.details: Certificate validity is 90 days (max 200)
checks.rationale: Long validity windows increase exposure when private keys are compromised.
checks.recommendation: Reissue certificate with validity at or below policy threshold.

checks.name: certificate_not_expired
checks.details: Certificate is within its validity window; expires 2026-07-30T00:00:00+00:00.
checks.policy_value: notAfter must be in the future
checks.rationale: An expired certificate is rejected by relying parties and provides no assurance.
checks.recommendation: Renew or replace the certificate before deploying it.

checks.name: certificate_not_yet_valid
checks.details: Certificate notBefore time has passed.
checks.policy_value: notBefore must be in the past
checks.rationale: A certificate used before its notBefore time fails path validation.
checks.recommendation: Wait until the notBefore time or reissue with a current validity window.

checks.name: certificate_expiry_window
checks.details: Renewal window warning disabled by policy (certificate.warn_if_expires_within_days=0).
checks.rationale: Certificates renewed inside a short window risk an outage if automation fails.
checks.recommendation: Renew the certificate before it enters the configured warning window.

checks.name: san_extension
checks.details: SAN extension present
checks.rationale: Modern TLS clients rely on SAN for hostname validation.
checks.recommendation: Issue certificate with SAN entries matching intended hostnames.

checks.name: key_algorithm_allowed
checks.details: Public key algorithm 'rsa' is permitted.
checks.rationale: Only approved public key algorithms carry assurance under the policy profile.
checks.recommendation: Reissue using a public key algorithm permitted by policy.

checks.name: rsa_key_size
checks.details: RSA key size is 2048 bits (min 2048)
checks.rationale: Weak RSA keys reduce cryptographic strength and trust assurance.
checks.recommendation: Generate key pair with RSA 2048+ before issuance.

checks.name: ec_key_size
checks.details: Key algorithm is 'rsa'; EC key size check not applicable.
checks.rationale: Undersized elliptic curve keys fall below the required security level.
checks.recommendation: Generate an EC key of at least the policy minimum size (P-256 or stronger).

checks.name: ec_curve_allowed
checks.details: Key algorithm is 'rsa'; EC curve check not applicable.
checks.rationale: Only NIST P-256, P-384 and P-521 are permitted for publicly trusted ECDSA keys.
checks.recommendation: Reissue using an approved named curve (secp256r1, secp384r1, secp521r1).

checks.name: signature_algorithm
checks.details: Signature algorithm is sha256 (sha256withrsaencryption)
checks.rationale: Deprecated hash algorithms can be vulnerable to collision attacks.
checks.recommendation: Use SHA-256 or stronger signature algorithm.

checks.name: signature_algorithm_oid
checks.details: Signature algorithm OID 1.2.840.113549.1.1.11 is permitted.
checks.rationale: The Baseline Requirements constrain the signature AlgorithmIdentifier, not just the digest name.
checks.recommendation: Sign with an allowed algorithm OID such as sha256WithRSAEncryption or ecdsa-with-SHA256.

checks.name: internal_domain_check
checks.details: No blocked internal domains detected
checks.rationale: Internal names are not valid for publicly trusted certificates.
checks.recommendation: Replace internal SAN values with public DNS names.

checks.name: dcv_method
checks.details: DCV checks disabled by policy (dcv.required=false).
checks.rationale: Domain Control Validation must use approved methods before issuance.
checks.recommendation: Use an approved DCV method and record validation evidence.

checks.name: dcv_recency
checks.details: DCV recency checks disabled by policy (dcv.required=false).
checks.rationale: Stale domain validation evidence can invalidate issuance decisions.
checks.recommendation: Re-run DCV within the allowed validation window.

checks.name: rfc5280_end_entity_ca
checks.details: RFC 5280 end-entity CA check disabled by policy.
checks.rationale: Subscriber certificates should not present CA basic constraints.
checks.recommendation: Issue end-entity certificate with BasicConstraints CA set to FALSE.

checks.name: rfc5280_key_usage_profile
checks.details: RFC 5280 key usage profile check disabled by policy.
checks.rationale: Key usage extensions must align with intended certificate purpose.
checks.recommendation: Set key usage extension to include required subscriber usages.

checks.name: rfc5280_subject_key_identifier
checks.details: RFC 5280 SKI check disabled by policy.
checks.rationale: SKI helps bind subject keys to certificate lifecycle and chain processing.
checks.recommendation: Include Subject Key Identifier extension for leaf profile consistency.

checks.name: rfc5280_authority_key_identifier
checks.details: RFC 5280 AKI check disabled by policy.
checks.rationale: AKI supports robust issuer key linkage during path validation.
checks.recommendation: Include Authority Key Identifier extension for issuer linkage.

checks.name: rfc5280_critical_extension_profile
checks.details: Critical extensions align with policy profile.
checks.rationale: Unexpected critical extensions can break relying-party validation behavior.
checks.recommendation: Restrict critical extensions to an approved extension profile.

checks.name: rfc5280_path_issuer_subject_match
checks.details: RFC 5280 issuer-subject path check disabled by policy.
checks.rationale: Issuer and subject linkage is required for path construction.
checks.recommendation: Provide the issuing certificate and validate issuer-subject linkage.

checks.name: rfc5280_path_aki_ski_match
checks.details: RFC 5280 AKI/SKI path check disabled by policy.
checks.rationale: AKI/SKI linkage improves deterministic path validation.
checks.recommendation: Ensure leaf AKI matches issuer SKI.

checks.name: issuance_hsm_attestation
checks.details: Issuance HSM attestation checks disabled by policy.
checks.rationale: Key custody controls require evidence of hardware-backed issuance operations.
checks.recommendation: Provide issuance attestation indicating HSM-backed key operations.

checks.name: issuance_fips_level
checks.details: Issuance FIPS level checks disabled by policy.
checks.rationale: Cryptographic module assurance levels are key audit controls.
checks.recommendation: Provide attested FIPS level meeting minimum policy requirement.

checks.name: crypto_transition_validity_target
checks.details: Crypto transition validity target check disabled by policy.
checks.rationale: Short-lived certificate profiles reduce exposure and improve rotation agility.
checks.recommendation: Reduce certificate validity to transition target or lower.

checks.name: crypto_transition_rsa_target
checks.details: Crypto transition RSA target check disabled by policy.
checks.rationale: Stronger key sizes improve resilience during algorithm transition periods.
checks.recommendation: Issue RSA certificates at or above the transition RSA key target.

checks.name: crypto_transition_signature_hash
checks.details: Crypto transition signature hash check disabled by policy.
checks.rationale: Approved signature hashes reduce risk from weak or deprecated digests.
checks.recommendation: Use signature hash algorithms from the approved transition allowlist.

checks.name: serial_entropy
checks.details: Serial number has 81 bits (min 64).
checks.rationale: Predictable serial numbers enable collision and tracking attacks; at least 64 bits of entropy is required.
checks.recommendation: Issue certificates with a cryptographically random serial of at least 64 bits.

checks.name: sct_presence
checks.details: SCT presence check disabled by policy (certificate.require_sct=false).
checks.rationale: Browser trust requires embedded Signed Certificate Timestamps.
checks.recommendation: Submit the precertificate to CT logs and embed the required SCTs.

checks.name: extended_key_usage
checks.details: EKU profile check disabled by policy (certificate.require_eku=false).
checks.rationale: EKU binds a certificate to an intended purpose such as TLS server authentication.
checks.recommendation: Include the required extendedKeyUsage values for the certificate profile.

trust_scope.reason: trust scope is public; CA/B Forum Baseline Requirements for publicly-trusted TLS are assessed
